The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, have officially released the RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026 notification under CEN No. 06/2026. This recruitment drive aims to fill 3,548 vacancies across non-technical popular categories for graduate candidates in Indian Railways.

Eligible individuals can submit their applications online through the official portal. The application window opened on October 8, 2026, and is scheduled to close on November 6, 2026, at 11:59 PM.

Available Positions and Vacancy Breakdown

The notification covers four key graduate-level posts within the railway network:

  • Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor
  • Goods Train Manager
  • Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist
  • Senior Clerk cum Typist

The highest allocation among these is designated for the Goods Train Manager position, accounting for 2,750 of the total 3,548 openings. Detailed distribution across regional railway zones and specific RRBs is outlined in Annexure B of the official notification. Officials note that these figures remain provisional and are subject to adjustment based on operational requirements.

Eligibility Criteria and Application Guidelines

Applicants must hold a recognized university degree or equivalent qualification on or before the final application deadline of November 6, 2026. Candidates awaiting final semester or year results are not eligible to apply. Notably, the typing skill test previously associated with certain clerical and accounts roles has been dispensed with for CEN No. 06/2026, though basic computer and typing proficiency will be evaluated post-appointment.

The age limit parameters are calculated as of January 1, 2027, with standard age relaxations applicable to designated reserved categories and serving railway personnel as stipulated in the guidelines.

A notable procedural update for this cycle involves the photograph submission process: candidates are not required to upload a pre-existing passport-size image. Instead, the portal captures a live photograph using a webcam or mobile front camera during the application process. Scanned signatures must be in JPG or JPEG format, sized between 30 KB and 49 KB with minimum dimensions of 140x60 pixels.

Selection Procedure and Application Correction

The recruitment process involves Computer-Based Tests (CBT), followed by Document Verification. Specific dates for the CBT stages and subsequent examination milestones will be announced independently by the RRBs.

Applicants are strictly restricted to submitting a single application under CEN No. 06/2026. Multiple submissions may result in total disqualification and future debarment. For those needing to amend details, an application correction window will run from November 9 to November 18, 2026, subject to a modification fee of ₹250 per instance. Core registration identifiers, such as the chosen RRB and primary contact details created during account setup, cannot be altered during this window.

Practical Implications and Verification

Candidates preparing to apply should carefully review the medical standards required for each position—such as the A2 medical standard mandated for Goods Train Managers—before locking in their post preferences. Furthermore, fee refunds are processed exclusively for candidates who physically appear for the 1st Stage CBT.

Readers can verify all primary announcements, check detailed regional vacancy allocations, and access the application portal directly through the official FreeJobAlert RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment Source.
